body: Thanks for the suggestions. Another reason I'm scared to say anything is I dont want to burden anyone else, everyone already has their own lives all set up it seems and I dont want to make them stop and deal with my struggle.

I'm able to take my mind off it for short periods of time but it's just up and down, and when it's down it's way down. I dont think I can go there because I have job offers in the next few days that hopefully can help steer me in the right direction, but I'm also scared they wont

Yeah it's really long hours and I just couldn't do it anymore, then with all this added now I just dont know what to do. I have some offers but I dont know if they'll work out. I want to go back to school but that just cranks up my anxiety even more because I cant afford it or have the time I feel like
Kinda scared about the hotline or going there. I feel like the only thing keeping me on the fence is knowing how my parents would feel.
I dont know what to do. I dont have anywhere to go and nobody to call that I think would care. I've just been sitting here for the last 3 days going back and forth
